description: Use this when someone wants one buyer persona's view in its own voice, e.g. "Ask our CISO persona whether they would pay for X". Get persona_key from gather_list_personas. The answer is grounded in the research behind the persona and is simulated, not a quote from a real person; when that research does not cover the question, the persona says so and GatherHQ logs the question to its research backlog. For how all the personas would react to a change, use gather_run_simulation.

question.description: The question for the persona, e.g. "What would make you switch?"

name: gather_ask_persona
title: Ask a buyer persona
